title: Inline Default Configuration Fallbacks (Scattered Presumptions)
pattern: Specifying default fallback values inline at various deep call sites rather than using a centralized registry.
why_bad: It introduces conflicting defaults across subsystems, causing the application to behave differently depending on which code path is initialized first.
detection: Identify raw string lookups with inline defaults for the same keys in different files.
counterexample: Isolated, component-specific defaults that are not part of global system properties.
fix: Define a single, centralized configuration struct with a unified `Default` implementation.
source: *Clean Code* by Robert C. Martin (2008), p. 306.
